issue_request: FHIR-48721 was Applied and resolved Persuasive with Modification for R6 by the CDS work group. It requested ArtifactAssessment checklist updates covering identifier/title wording, removal of content.informationType, content.author cardinality, freeToShare wording and inheritance comment, content.component wording, Boundaries and Relationships text, FiveWs mapping, and examples.
initial_application: Commit 1789a2f15b, merged by HL7/fhir pull request #3244 in ed2e61ba7e, applied most requested StructureDefinition, example, mapping, and terminology changes. It removed content.informationType and its terminology, updated identifier/freeToShare/component/author/FiveWs source, and updated examples, but left ArtifactAssessment.title without the requested definition and did not update the Boundaries and Relationships referenced-by sentence.
additional_context: ArtifactAssessment is active build-scope source in source/fhir.ini. Later commit 050832a81c removed EvidenceReport from the related introduction paragraph as part of EvidenceReport de-listing, so no additional EvidenceReport replacement was needed there. Citation was later removed from core build scope and audited separately for FHIR-48855, but current ArtifactAssessment narrative already names Citation as a likely referenced knowledge artifact and FHIR-48721 specifically requested Citation in the referenced-by sentence. Bounded Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no conflicting community or related-issue evidence.
reconciliation: Added the requested ArtifactAssessment.title definition in the authoritative StructureDefinition source and updated the ArtifactAssessment introduction Boundaries and Relationships referenced-by sentence to include ArtifactAssessment, Citation, Composition, and Task. No generated SVG was edited and no redundant change was made to the EvidenceReport/Composition paragraph because current source already removed EvidenceReport and names Composition.
